source.source_text: namo'stu devi ādau ca madhye tubhyaṃ namo'stu te | etat stutipadaṃ kṛtvā tathedaṃ vākyamabravīt —

T1.close_translation: "[and]-homage-be-to-you, O-Devī, at-the-first, indeed, [and]-in-the-midst, to-you-homage-be-to-you: [and]-having-made-this-praise-step (stuti-pada), [and]-thus-this-speech-he-told:" "[Bhairava:] In-this-great-terrible-seat (pīṭha), crowded-with-the-heroes-of-heroes (*?), why-are-they-come, all, the-sixty-four-great-mighty (catuḥṣaṣṭi-mahābalā), O-supreme-mistress: the-yoginīs, the-heroes-of-heroes (*?), [and]-the-hero-born (vīrajāḥ), O-supreme-mistress, [and]-the-devoted-to-your-worship, the-great-yoga-lords (mahāyogendra), the-eager (*?): [and]-the-always-joined, the-rite-knowers (vidhāna-jña), all, [and]-the-foremost-in-all (*?): [and]-delighting-in-your-service (*?), [and]-the-exceedingly-glad-faced (*?):"
